units.source_text: “如果连他弟弟也带来，家里的织机不就得停下来了吗？

en.t: If he brought even his younger brother along, wouldn't the looms at home have to stop?

units.source_text: 加上这孩子个性倔强，我想让他在我喜欢的樟树林荫道上走走，

en.t: Besides, this boy is stubborn by nature, so I want him to walk along the camphor tree avenue I love,

units.source_text: 也许能使他受到熏陶，变得温柔些……”

en.t: and perhaps it will influence him and make him a little gentler..."
